title: Senior Product Manager - Investing (f/m/x)
jd_excerpt:
About lemon.markets 🍋
 We grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses, providing seamless access to capital markets. We enable everyone to be an investor.
 lemon.markets builds infrastructure for financial services and technology companies powering the next generation of investment products. From enabling a FinTech to launch their first investment product, over allowing e.g. a Neobank to embed investing into their product to bringing investing into a completely new context. Our API-first infrastructure makes launching an investment product customer-centric and compliant. We abstract all complexity for our partners through a well documented API, a self-service customer operations portal and operating in a clear regulatory framework. Enabling partners to launch in weeks, not months.
 We have experienced first hand that brokerage infrastructure is broken. Building an investment product used to be highly expensive, challenging and cumbersome. We ease this pain by shielding our partners & their customers from the underlying complexity - and with that we make investing more accessible to everyone. Because that’s exactly what we enjoy, going to places nobody else dares and solving hard problems. This not only creates tons of value when done right, but attracts the smartest minds - because outlier companies are built by exceptional (& diverse) people like you.
 Your Mission: 
 As Senior Product Manager, Investing, you own this domain end to end. You set its strategy and roadmap, run discovery and delivery, and answer for its outcomes. You represent the domain to some of the biggest financial institutions in Europe and to our dwpbank counterparts, and you are the go-to person internally, collaborating where it moves us forward and holding the line where it matters.
 Reporting to the Head of Product, you lead the domain's product work. The remit is large, strategically and in delivery, and it grows as the domain grows. Success looks like partners shipping compliant products on our infrastructure without us being the bottleneck.
 You will: 
 Own the Investing product domain and its outcomes, from problem framing through to launch, adoption, and iteration
 Run product discovery and delivery inside a cross-functional crew with operations and engineering
 Shape and drive the strategy and roadmap for the entire domain: order flow, execution, trading mechanics, tax, corporate actions, and the instrument universe
 Act as the domain go-to person and go-to expert for everything that happens before and after an order
 Engage directly with enterprise partners and prospects: scope requirements, negotiate delivery, prioritise
 Partner with risk, finance, and compliance so that what we build is compliant by design
 Work across other product teams and solutions engineering to keep partner-specific integrations sustainable on our platform
 You will be successful in this role if: 
 You have at least four years of product experience and have independently shipped complex products from problem definition through launch and iteration.
 You have strong product craft , combining customer insight, business thinking and technical understanding to make sound product decisions.
 You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and are comfortable experimenting with them, challenging their limitations and finding practical ways to improve your output.
 You are comfortable with ambiguity , bringing structure to unclear problem spaces and making confident decisions before every answer is available.
 You use data and evidence to guide your decisions , while remaining open to changing your position when new information emerges.
 You build trust across Engineering, Compliance and enterprise partnerships , communicate clearly in writing and bring the energy to challenge assumptions and move people forward.
 You thrive on ownership. You are intrinsically motivated to create impact by delivering high quality outcomes for our customers by taking initiative and challenging the status quo.
 You have a collaborative mindset . Working together as a team and sharing knowledge comes natural to you. While you will have a lot of autonomy delivering your projects, you understand the necessity of cross-functional work, a certain pragmatism & dedication to our mission.
 You are a great communicator in English and German . . Working in a start-up can be messy & unstructured at times, you’re able to sift through the noise, and assess what's really critical. You create buy-in for your plans from your stakeholders by applying a strong writing culture.
 How we take care of you: 
 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets .
 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.
 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.
 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.
